item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 09/Apr/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The weather will be mainly fine over Guangdong in the next couple of days. It will be hot during the day. Winds will become weak and the visibility will be relatively low. The northeast monsoon is expected to reach the coastal areas midweek next week, it will be cloudier with a few showers over the region. Besides, the tropical cyclone over the adjacent seas to the east of the Philippines will move slowly in the next couple of days. Tropical Cyclone Malakas over the western North Pacific will move across the seas east of the Philippines in the next couple of days and intensify gradually. It will then subsequently move in the general direction of the seas south of Japan.
